title: I was waited for
body: I like and use Daily Routine since previous classic Daily routine. Even though there are lots of things to fix or do improve, it’s still worth.  However, I feel it is still in the beta . And I hesitate to buy/subscribe. The price of one-time purchase is too expensive for the app with many bugs.
author: kirin giraff

title: Great design and update, but...
body: When using repeating blocks I cannot delete only one instance. I can only delete all repeating elements or all repeating elements in the future. Of course one needs the option to change the timeframe or delete one instance in the event series without affecting the others. Second the calender integration is no more. I loved seeing my appointments, too. If these two features are added it is definitely 5⭐️
author: ma_ke
